integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] At 0.000 seconds: high-quality 3D-rendered mecha style with glossy metallic blue armor, gold accent panels, and intense cyan-blue energy glows. An eye-level medium-wide shot frames the humanoid mecha from <Picture 1> head-on, preserving its angular armored silhouette, glowing cyan eyes, radiant chest reactor, and the massive energy blade held in its right hand. The transformation begins at real-time speed: chest armor panels slide open with a mechanical clack, cables snap taut, the chest reactor blooms from dim to brilliant, and energy conduits trace cyan light down the frame; shoulder vent ports hiss open and release short jets of blue-white plasma, and the energy blade wakes with a low hum and a surge of brightness. The camera holds the front angle with a slow heroic push-in, lighting blooming from the chest and eyes.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.200 seconds: hard cut to a rear three-quarter view as the back armor begins its own transformation — the backpack panels slide open, the thruster nozzles extend and rotate outward, then ignite with steady blue plasma jets that were not there a moment before; spine exhaust ports vent steam, and the secondary rear reactor pulses in sync with the chest core. The camera holds steady on the rear, slight push, so the thrusters' change from retracted to fully lit is clearly read. Servos whine and armor slams as the back seals.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000 seconds: hard cut to a top-down overhead shot, camera looking straight down as the transformation completes and the stance fully opens — the mecha's complete geometry reads from above: both feet planted wide in a grounded crouch, shoulder armor fanned outward, the energy blade angled across the body, and a cyan-blue energy ring blooming and radiating speed-lines across the floor beneath it. The overhead angle shows off the whole battle stance as a single striking silhouette, the thruster glows and ground ring pulsing in sync. The camera lingers just long enough to register the full pose, then begins a slow descent toward the front.

[Shot 4] At 00:05.300 seconds: hard cut to a low-angle shot from below and in front, the camera tilted up to make the mecha loom tall and imposing — the towering armored frame, the diagonal energy blade, the blue flames behind it all reading as dominance. From this low heroic angle the mecha demonstrates its strike: the blade draws back across the body in a tight wind-up, reactor spiking, then whips forward through a decisive diagonal slash; the low angle makes the cut feel crushing, the blade carving a bright cyan arc-trail upward through the air, torso and rear leg driving the blow, the surrounding blue flames lashing outward at the point of the swing. A percussive metallic slash whoosh rings out.

[Shot 5] At 00:07.000 seconds: hard cut back to an eye-level medium front shot as the mecha settles — the blade coming down to a low relaxed forward rest rather than a stiff guard, weight even, reactor pulsing in a calm steady beat, thrusters and plasma drifting around the armor. It holds there, front-facing, alive with micro-motion — cool because the sequence built to this from overhead and below, not because it posed.

overall_soundscape: Mechanical clacks as armor panels slide, a rising reactor hum, hiss of venting plasma, servos whining as the back thrusters extend, a deep thruster ignition roar, the ground energy ring's low resonant bloom on the overhead cut, the energy blade's crackling buzz building into the slash, a powerful metallic slash whoosh, then a soft metallic exhale as the blade settles and a steady thruster drone.

non_diegetic_music: Epic orchestral-mechanical hybrid with heavy brass, low choir, and industrial percussion; a slow building crescendo through the transformation, a wide sustained swell under the overhead top-down reveal of the full stance, a sharp percussive brass hit on the low-angle slash, then the arrangement easing into a sustained powerful-but-relaxed chord that keeps a living pulse rather than a frozen sting.
